fullContent:
Gulguluthikthakam Kashayam 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridaya Chikitsa Sthana 21/57-60 
 Gulguluthikthakam Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine, available in the herbal decoction form. It is used to treat the inflammatory conditions of skin, joints and bones. For skin and joints problems it balances Vata and Kapha. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Neem – Azadirachta indica 
 Patola – Trichosanthes dioica 
 Vyaghri – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 Guduchi – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Vasa – Adhatoda vasica 
 Patha – Cyclea peltata / Cissampelos pariera 
 Vidanga – Embelia ribes 
 Suradaru – Cedrus deodara 
 Gajopakulya – Piper chaba 
 Yavakshara – Hordeum vulgare 
 Sarjikshara – An alkali 
 Dry ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Turmeric – curcuma longa 
 Mishreya – Anethum sowa 
 Chavya – Piper chaba 
 Kushta – Saussurea lappa 
 Tejovati – Zanthoxylum alatum 
 Maricha – Black pepper 
 Ajwain – Trachyspermum ammi 
 Chitrak – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Kutki – Picrorrhiza kurroa 
 Bhallatak – Purified Semecarpus anacardium 
 Vacha – Acorus calamus 
 Pippali – Piper longum – root 
 Yukta – Pluchea lanceolata 
 Manjishta – Rubia cordifolia 
 Ativisha – Aconitum heterophyllum 
 Vishani – Aconitum species 
 Shuddha Guggulu – Purified Commiphora mukul 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 The ingredients are used to prepare water decoction. 
 Dosage 
 Take 5 – 10 ml, before food, or on empty stomach, once or twice a day or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Psoriasis 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Gout 
 Healing wounds 
 Abscess 
 Sinuses 
 Fistula 
 Atopic dermatitis 
 Allergic dermatitis 
 Hives 
 Lumbar 
 Cervical spondylitis 
 
 Side Effects 
 High dosage may worsen gastritis. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
